_about: Public-domain Benjamin Wallin, Particular Baptist minister at Maze Pond, Southwark, for the Word Hoard: The Christian Life in Divers of its Branches, The Redeemer's Charge against his Declining Churches, Evangelical Hymns and Songs, The Experience of the Saints, Lectures on Primitive Christianity, Superabounding Grace, and his many funeral, ordination and association sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 124 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wallin-compassion-dying-saviour: The compassion of the dying Saviour to those that crucified him, consider'd and improved, in a sermon on Luke xxiii.34. By Benjamin Wallin.  1746 (catalogued 1746)
wallin-christian-life-divers: The Christian life, in divers of its branches described and recommended. In four parts. Being the substance of several discourses on Philippans iv. from the 4th to the 7th verse inclusive. To which is added A serious exhortation to prayer; in two Sermons on 1 Thess. v.17. By Benjamin Wallin.  1746 (catalogued 1746)
wallin-exhortation-against-quenching: An exhortation against quenching the spirit. A sermon preached to a society of young men, November the 7th, 1748. By Benjamin Wallin. ...  1748 (catalogued 1748)
wallin-redeemers-charge-against: The Redeemer's charge against his declining churches : exemplified in the case of the church of Ephesus (London : Printed for J. Ward, 1748)
wallin-ability-christ-save: The ability of Christ to save, the believer's comfort in the near views of eternity. A sermon occasioned by the death of Mr. Jonas Thurrowgood, ... July 2, 1753. By Benjamin Wallin.  1753 (catalogued 1753)
wallin-appearance-deceased-saints: The appearance of deceased saints with their Lord, at His coming, the consolation of surviving believers. A sermon occasioned by the death of Mr. Edward Tomkins, who departed this life, March 9, 1753. By Benjamin Wallin.  1753 (catalogued 1753)
wallin-gods-relation-faithful: God's relation to the faithful after their decease, a proof of their present life, and future resurrection. A sermon occasioned by the death of Mr. Thomas Wildman, who departed this life, June 25, 1754, ... By Benjamin Wallin.  1754 (catalogued 1754)
wallin-obligations-people-faithful: The obligations of a people to their faithful minister. Represented in a discourse preached at the ordination of the Revd. Mr. Samuel Burford, September 4, 1755. By Benjamin Wallin.  1755 (catalogued 1755)
wallin-christians-duty-confidence: The Christian's duty and confidence in times of public calamity. Being several discourses occasioned by the late dreadful earthquakes and the apprehensions of a French war. By Benjamin Wallin.  1756 (catalogued 1756)
wallin-folly-neglecting-divine: The folly of neglecting divine institutions. An earnest address to th Christian, who continues to refrain from the appointments of the gospel: ... By Benjamin Wallin.  1758 (catalogued 1758)
wallin-joyful-sacrifice-prosperous: The joyful sacrifice of a prosperous nation. A sermon preached at the meeting-house near the Maze-Pond, Southwark, on Thursday November 29, 1759; ... By Benjamin Wallin.  1760 (catalogued 1760)
wallin-faith-christ-life: Faith in Christ, and life everlasting. A sermon occasioned by the death of the Rev. Mr. John Auther, who departed this life, July 10, 1762, ... By Benjamin Wallin.  1762 (catalogued 1762)
wallin-evangelical-hymns-songs: Evangelical hymns and songs, in two parts: the first, composed on various views of the Christian life and warfare; the second, in praise of the Redeemer: published for the comfort & entertainment of true Christians. By Benjamin Wallin. To which is added, a collection of hymns from Dr. Watts's forty-four sermons: and, Mr. Stennet's sacramental hymns.  1762 (catalogued 1762)
wallin-experience-saints-asserted: The experience of the saints asserted and proved. Being several discourses in which the ground of a believer's hope, with the nature of Christian experience, and the operations of the Holy Spirit, are briefly explained and defended. By Benjamin Wallin.  1763 (catalogued 1763)
wallin-universal-concern-saints: The universal concern of saints in communion, represented in a sermon, the substance of which was delivered to the church, meeting near Devonshire-Square. At the ordination of the Rev. Mr. Walter Richards, to the pastoral-office, and of Messrs. J. Tomkins, T. Cooke and G. Wilkinson, to the office of deacons, December 14, 1762. By Benjamin Wallin.  1763 (catalogued 1763)
wallin-christians-concern-that: The christian's concern that he may not be a cast-away: exemplified in the conduct of the apostle Paul. Being two discourses on I Cor. ix. 27. ... By Benjamin Wallin.  1765 (catalogued 1765)
wallin-fall-mighty-just: The fall of the mighty, a just cause of universal lamentation. A sermon on the decease of His Royal Highness the illustrious and heroic Prince William-Augustus Duke of Cumberland. By Benjamin Wallin.  1765 (catalogued 1765)
wallin-christian-salutation-farewel: The Christian salutation. A farewel-sermon delivered October 12, 1766. on the return of the congregation under the care of the Rev. Mr. John Rogers, ... By Benjamin Wallin.  1766 (catalogued 1766)
wallin-constitution-gospel-church: The constitution of a Gospel-church adapted to union and peace, a sermon, delivered October 2, 1766. To the church meeting near Cripple-Gate, on the ordination of the Rev. Mr. John Reynolds. By Benjamin Wallin.  1766 (catalogued 1766)
wallin-eternal-existence-lord: The eternal existence of the Lord Jesus Christ considered and improved. A sermon, the substance of which was lately delivered at a monthly association, in Grafton-Street, near the Seven-Dials. By Benjamin Wallin.  1766 (catalogued 1766)
wallin-everlasting-communion-saints: The everlasting communion of saints with their Lord in the kingdom of Heaven their comfort, when mourning the loss of their fellow-communicants on earth. A sermon occasioned by the decease of Mrs. Mary Keene; ... By Benjamin Wallin.  1767 (catalogued 1767)
wallin-lectures-primitive-christianity: Lectures on primitive Christianity in doctrine, experience, worship, discipline and mannners : as it appeared in the church at Jerusalem in the time of the Apostles; also on the epistle to the church at Sardis and on the faithful in the days of Malachi, interspersed with notes, reflections, and addresses with a view to awaken a becoming zeal for the communion of saints, in order and love (London : Printed for the author, 1768)
wallin-eternal-mansion-prepared: An eternal mansion prepared in the heavens for the righteous. A sermon occasioned by the decease of Mr. Thomas Cox, who departed this life, August 20, 1769, in the 73d year of his age. By Benjamin Wallin.  1769 (catalogued 1769)
wallin-charge-together-with: A charge and sermon together with an introductory discourse and confession of faith delivered at the ordination of the Rev. Mr. Abraham Booth Feb.16, 1769, in Goodman's Fields ...  1769 (catalogued 1769)
wallin-universal-character-departed: The universal character of departed saints. A sermon occasioned by the death of Mrs. Rebekah Cox, ... September 19, 1769. ... By Benjamin Wallin.  1769 (catalogued 1769)
wallin-gospel-requisites-acceptable: Gospel-requisites to acceptable prayer. A sermon delivered at a monthly association, in Unicorn-Yard, Tooley-Street, Southwark, on Thursday, February the 22d, 1770. By Benjamin Wallin.  1770 (catalogued 1770)
wallin-importance-family-religion: The importance of family-religion. A sermon; the substance of which was delivered at the meeting-house, near Devonshire-Square, on Thursday, November the 22d, 1770. By Benjamin Wallin, M.A.  1771 (catalogued 1771)
wallin-blessedness-man-whom: The blessedness of the man, whom the Lord shall find diligent in his station. A sermon occasioned by the death of Mr. Job Heath; who departed this life, January 24, 1773. in the 52d year of his age. By Benjamin Wallin, M.A.  1773 (catalogued 1773)
wallin-happiness-saints-separate: The happiness of the saints in a separate state. A sermon preached at Hitchin, in Herts, Aug. 27, 1773, at the funeral of ... Mr. Samuel James, ... By Benjamin Wallin, ...  1773 (catalogued 1773)
wallin-fountain-life-freely: The fountain of life freely opened to the willing-hearted sinner. A sermon occasioned by the death of Miss Elizabeth Macgowan, who departed this life, February 19, 1774, ... To which is annexed, the hymn sung on the occasion. By Benjamin Wallin, A.M.  1774 (catalogued 1774)
wallin-popular-concern-choice: The popular concern in the choice of representatives. A sermon delivered ... October 9, 1774. By Benjamin Wallin, ...  1774 (catalogued 1774)
wallin-memoirs-gentleman-lately: Memoirs of a gentleman lately deceased; chiefly concerning his convictions on the verge of eternity: ...  1774 (catalogued 1774)
wallin-case-fallen-professor: The case of a fallen professor, stated and considered. A sermon on Proverbs XXV. 26. By Benjamin Wallin. A.M.  1775 (catalogued 1775)
wallin-superabounding-grace-forgiveness: Superabounding grace, in the forgiveness of penitent transgressors, exemplified and vindicated. Being discourses on the parable of the prodigal son. In four parts. ... By Benjamin Wallin, M.A.  1775 (catalogued 1775)
wallin-ancient-believers-transition: The ancient believers transition from mortality to life. A sermon occasioned by the decease of Mrs. Hannah Munn, late of Watford, Herts, who departed this life, October 1, 1779, in the eighty-fourth year of her age. By Benjamin Wallin, A.M.  1779 (catalogued 1779)
